reports.title: Spike Trap Reported on N1 Northbound near Pumulani Toll
reports.description: Road spikes hidden under cardboard boxes observed near kilometer marker 34. Two vehicles pulled over with flat tyres.
reports.adminNotes: Verified by Highway Patrol Unit 4. Tow trucks dispatched.

aiAnalysis.summary: High threat spike hazard reported on major transit route. High risk of armed ambush or loss of vehicle control.
aiAnalysis.warningText: DO NOT STOP if tyres puncture. Continue at low speed to safe, lit petrol station.
aiAnalysis.suggestedAction: Reroute via R101 or maintain extreme vigilance.

reports.title: Severe Congestion & Stalled Truck on M1 South @ Woodmead
reports.description: Heavy duty vehicle breakdown blocking middle 2 lanes. Traffic backed up 6km past Buccleuch interchange.
reports.adminNotes: Traffic Metro Police on scene directing flow.

aiAnalysis.summary: Major arterial traffic bottleneck. Estimated delay: +35 mins.
aiAnalysis.suggestedAction: Consider taking N3 or Bowling Ave detour.

reports.title: Spike Trap & Metal Strips Verified on R21 South near OR Tambo
reports.description: Sharp homemade metal spike rods hidden inside cardboard bags across slow lane on R21 South before Voortrekker offramp.
reports.adminNotes: Confirmed by interceptor unit. SAPS notified.

aiAnalysis.summary: Critical spiking threat signature confirmed. High risk of ambush.
aiAnalysis.warningText: Do not pull over on shoulder. Drive to nearby illuminated fuel station.

reports.title: Spike Trap Obstacle on N4 Highway near Solomon Mahlangu Offramp

reports.adminNotes: Patrol unit en route for debris clearance.

aiAnalysis.summary: Active spike obstacle. Potential ambush hazard.
aiAnalysis.suggestedAction: Slow down and maintain safe visual range.

drivingCourseSettings.title: Advanced Defensive & Anti-Hijack Driving Course
drivingCourseSettings.subtitle: Official Live Traffic NPC Motorist Safety Academy (Strictly 10 per class)
drivingCourseSettings.description: Master skidpan recovery, high-speed emergency lane change, hijack avoidance maneuvers, and vehicle defense under professional instruction in Johannesburg and Pretoria.
drivingCourseSettings.requirementsNotice: Mandatory Requirements: Valid South African ID or Passport + Valid Driver's License (Code B or above). Classes are strictly capped at 10 drivers per date for hands-on vehicle track time.
drivingCourseSettings.waitlistNoticeText: Classes are limited to 10 drivers per session to ensure hands-on track time and 1-on-1 instructor coaching. Advertised dates are confirmed in advance; walk-in same-day arrivals are not permitted.

curriculumModules.title: Skidpan Oversteer & Wet Surface Recovery
curriculumModules.desc: Hands-on correction of sudden loss of traction, aquaplaning recovery, and emergency counter-steering on slick surfaces.

curriculumModules.title: Anti-Hijack & Threat Evasion Maneuvers
curriculumModules.desc: Tactical escape techniques: the J-turn, high-speed reverse maneuvering, ramming escape awareness, and situational threat identification.

curriculumModules.title: High-Speed Emergency Braking & ABS Slalom
curriculumModules.desc: Threshold braking at speed while swerving around sudden roadblocks, spikes, or stopped vehicles without destabilizing your car.

curriculumModules.title: Spike Hazard & Night Driving Counter-Measures
curriculumModules.desc: Specialized techniques for maintaining vehicle control and safe roll-out after striking tyre-damaging spikes or debris.

curriculumModules.title: Official Live Traffic NPC Certification
curriculumModules.desc: Graduates receive a verified Advanced Driver Safety Certificate recognized by selected insurance and corporate fleets.
